## Background 

Blueprint has used public data to analyze municipal funding gaps in Peel (@mcmanus2024) and York (@meagher2026) Regions. 
Community Development Halton (CDH) has expressed interest in commissioning a similar analysis focused on Halton Region. 
This quote outlines the proposed scope of work, key activities, deliverables, and budget for that analysis. 

This analysis will provide CDH with a data-driven understanding of the provincial funding that municipalities and non-profits in Halton Region receive, and how it differs from the funding received by municipalities and non-profits in other similar regions of Ontario. 
Ultimately, it will equip CDH and its partners to bring rigorously derived evidence to bear in conversations about the distribution of provincial funding across Ontario. 

## Scope of Work

The scope of work for this project includes the development of a Halton Region Funding Analysis Report and support for CDH's subsequent reporting and knowledge mobilization activities. 

### Deliverable

The Halton Region Funding Analysis Report will include:

- A methodology section, clearly describing the data sources, data processing steps, and analytical methods used in the analysis.
- A results section, following the format of the Peel and York Region analyses, presenting the findings of the analysis in a clear and accessible manner, using tables and visualizations as appropriate.

CDH will have the opportunity to review and provide feedback on a draft version of the report before the final version is delivered. 

### Reporting and Knowledge Mobilization Support

In addition to the report itself, Blueprint will provide support for CDH's reporting and knowledge mobilization activities related to the analysis.

This may include: 

- Advising on the development of presentations or other materials to communicate the findings of the analysis to various audiences.
- Participating in meetings or presentations to help communicate the findings of the analysis to stakeholders.
- Providing guidance on how to use the findings of the analysis to inform advocacy efforts or other initiatives aimed at addressing funding gaps in Halton Region.
